title: CRM module settings
description: Operator settings of the CRM module. Passwords and API keys are never settings: they live in the module's Secrets.

from_address.description: From address of mail the CRM sends (needs email.send).

enabled.description: Create a contact for each form submission once the adapter exists.

form_ids.description: Only these forms feed the CRM; empty means every form.

contact_retention_days.description: Matches the crm-contact data class (3y), counted from the last activity.
